static_traits.name: Chen Wenjun
static_traits.family_status: Has an older sister; usually enjoys cooking for family and friends
static_traits.social_status: Has interpersonal support (family and friends can confide in), but has not yet discussed these specific feelings with them; inferiority affecting relationships with family and friends
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; never received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, highly cooperative; able to self-Reflect; emotions generally stable but slightly tense; willing to try exercises and journaling

basic_info.main_problem: I still love my ex-boyfriend, and feel inadequate about cooking. The inferiority began at my sister's wedding when she hired outside catering instead of letting me do it, and the problem worsened after this; especially obvious when cooking for others or encountering food-related activities.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these feelings of inferiority are affecting my self-esteem and mental health, and therefore come to seek counseling; I want to overcome this feeling, enjoy cooking again as before, and change my negative thinking patterns.
growth_experiences: At my sister's wedding, my sister chose to hire professional catering instead of letting me cater; afterward developing intense feelings of inadequacy about cooking and comparison psychology, gradually worsening. Previously, I often cooked for family and friends and received praise and recognition, but after the wedding event began second-guessing, constantly Self-denial, interpreting my sister's choice as 'I am not good enough/my level does not meet the Demands of large occasions'.
After breaking up with my ex-boyfriend, still holding emotional attachment to him ('still loving my ex-boyfriend'), this unresolved relationship experience intertwined with Impaired self-esteem.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough(not capable enough)
My worth depends on my performance in front of others (especially cooking)

special_situations.event: Choosing to hire professional catering at my sister's wedding instead of letting me do it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If family does not choose me to take on cooking for important occasions, it proves I am not good enough/not qualified
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding Cooking for others, indulging in Self-doubt and self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She does not let me do it because I am not good enough, I disappointed my family

special_situations.event: Before Cooking for others, Anticipating possibly being evaluated or making mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as any mistake appears, it proves I am a terrible cook
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to Avoids cooking occasions, to avoid possible failure and criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up; something will definitely go wrong

special_situations.event: Continuously focusing on possible flaws and problems during cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must be perfect to count as qualified, otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive Self-monitoring and repeatedly negating completed steps, finding it hard to acknowledge current performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This dish is not good enough, no matter how I do it, it does not meet the standard

special_situations.event: After receiving praise and affirmation from others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' positive feedback is not reliable, only criticism is truly valid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive feedback, attributing praise to 'politeness', to prevent expectations from being shattered
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, actually I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be affirmed through cooking skills by family and significant others, to be appreciated and needed
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, being judged as 'not good enough', feeling shame and Being rejected as a result
defense_goal: By avoiding occasions of being evaluated and negating positive feedback to reduce Anxiety and shame

object_relations.self_representation: not qualified, a provider/Chef who may make mistakes at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judgers (such as family / others / professionals)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing my sister's wedding and her choice, or when asked why others did not let me cater
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting others' choices as negation of one's ability (Projecting inner shame as 'they think I am not good enough')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Insisting in an affirmative tone that 'they look down on me/do not trust me', use absolutist words, ignoring alternative Interpretations.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others give positive feedback and affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing praise is only out of politeness, not reflecting true ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds to praise in a flat or even downplaying tone, attributing it to 'politeness / courtesy', downplaying emotional engagement.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to cook for others or facing situations where one may be evaluated
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing potential mistakes as a threat that would 'prove oneself utterly worthless'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Politely declines or finds objective reasons to avoid tasks, cautious tone, showing little emotion.

manifestations: Although having support from family and friends, has not yet discussed the specific inferiority and distress with them
After breaking up with the ex-boyfriend, still deeply emotionally attached, experiencing relationship-level gaps and Loneliness
outcomes: Avoiding cooking and evaluation scenarios, reducing genuine contact with others

manifestations: Treats the inner requirement that 'it must be perfect to count as qualified' as a guideline, restricting their choices in cooking and socializing
outcomes: Increased behavioral avoidance, decreased tolerance for experiences
Hard to spontaneously enjoy cooking and interpersonal interaction

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Constantly Self-doubting and over-checking in the kitchen, using the inner monologue of 'I am not good enough'
Worries about being evaluated and is overly cautious, reducing direct contact with others

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Interpreting my sister's hiring of outside catering as negation of one's ability
Views others' praise as 'politeness', finding it hard to internalize positive feedback

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Holds the implicit rule 'on important occasions it must be done perfectly by me to count as qualified'
Demanding of oneself with 'should/must' standards to reach a professional level at large events

positive_force: Has long cooked for family and friends and gained affirmation, possessing actual cooking ability and successful experience
Having family and friends who can provide support (though not yet discussing the specific distress)
Work stable, not yet noticeably affected, life structure relatively stable
Positive attitude, willing to challenge negative thinking through recording and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Tends toward social comparison and resulting inferiority
Negating positive feedback, over-focusing on negative information (mental filtering)
Avoiding and Withdrawing when facing evaluation, reducing practice opportunities
Catastrophic Anticipation of failure, Reinforcing Self-doubt
The unresolved emotional ties with the ex-boyfriend affecting self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding Cooking for others (trying not to cook in Social situations)
antecedent: Being invited or having the chance to cook for others
Activities or topics related to food/banquets appear
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing my sister's wedding choice as Self-denial, viewing performance with perfectionist standards, worrying any mistake proves oneself 'utterly worthless'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and failure, relieving Anxiety and shame in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Interaction with family and friends is limited, self-esteem keeps being damaged, hard to enjoy cooking again

target_behavior.behavior: Negating positive feedback (Interpreting praise as politeness)
antecedent: Receives others' praise and positive evaluations after cooking
target_behavior.core_reason: To maintain the core belief 'I am not good enough' and avoid the blow of being negated in the future, tending to Rationalize praise with 'politeness'
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty internalizing positive experiences, Reinforcing Self-doubt and low self-esteem, maintaining the negative cognitive cycle
